Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.chains

Class ActionConfigFacade

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.chains.ActionConfigFacade
@Component public class ActionConfigFacade extends Object
Provides a facade of commonly used action patterns for GUI automation using the modern ActionConfig API.

This class encapsulates frequent action combinations into simple, reusable methods. It reduces code duplication and improves readability across automation scripts by providing a higher-level abstraction over the core Action API with type-safe configuration objects.

Key features:

  • Type-safe configuration with specific Options classes
  • Better IDE support with auto-completion
  • Clear API with method names that match intent
  • Support for action chaining through fluent API

Common usage patterns: 


 // Simple click with timeout
 facade.click(5.0, stateImage);

 // Double-click at location
 facade.doubleClick(location);

 // Right-click on best match
 facade.rightClickBest(0.9, stateImage);

 // Type with modifiers
 facade.typeWithModifiers("v", "CTRL");

 // Click until vanished
 facade.clickUntilVanished(10, 0.5, stateImage);
Since:
2.0

      public boolean click(Location location)
      Performs a single left click at the specified screen location.

    • clickUntilVanished

      public boolean clickUntilVanished(double timeout, StateImage... stateImages)
      Repeatedly clicks an image until it disappears from the screen.

      This method is useful for dismissing dialogs, clearing notifications, or interacting with UI elements that require multiple clicks to disappear.

      Parameters:
      timeout - Maximum time in seconds to wait for images to vanish
      stateImages - Images to click until they vanish
      Returns:
      true if the images vanished, false if timeout reached
